title: Cyto 2026 Poster - Cytometry In R
text:
Cyto 2026 Poster - Cytometry In R
This is the repository for our Cyto 2026 “Cytometry in R” late-breaker poster.
Click here to navigate to the .pdf of the poster, which can be downloaded.
For our Cytometry in R course, click here.


GitHub repository organization.
Within this GitHub repository due to size limits, we are unable to provide the .svg files that were used to create the poster in Inkscape, feel free to reach out to the UMGCCC Flow Cytometry Shared Resource email (“flowcore”, “@”, “som.umaryland.edu”) to get a sharable copy.
The code to generate QR codes and extract survey comments in R can be found under the code_poster folder. Actual QR codes generated can be found under outputs folder. Images used that were brought in from other sources can be found in the images folder.


License
In our commitment to open-science and open-source, all teaching materials are freely offered under a CC-BY-SA license, while all code examples are offered under the AGPL3-0 copyleft license.

Helper Function

QR_Helper <- function(url, output, filename){

code <- qr_code(url)

TheFileName  <- paste0(filename, ".svg")

StoreHere <- file.path(output, TheFileName)

generate_svg(code, filename = StoreHere)
#plot(code)
}

title: Survey Comments
text:
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)


Attaching package: 'dplyr'


The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':

    filter, lag


The following objects are masked from 'package:base':

    intersect, setdiff, setequal, union



    parse_comments <- function(filepath) {
    raw <- readLines(filepath, warn = FALSE)
    raw <- raw[nzchar(trimws(raw))]          # drop blank lines

    records <- list()
    i <- 1
    while (i <= length(raw)) {
        country_line <- raw[i]
        comment_line <- if (i + 1 <= length(raw)) raw[i + 1] else ""

        country <- str_trim(str_remove(country_line, "^Country:\\s*"))
        comment <- str_trim(str_remove(comment_line, "^Comment:\\s*"))

        records[[length(records) + 1]] <- list(country = country, comment = comment)
        i <- i + 2
    }
    records
    }

    render_comment_png <- function(country, comment, out_path, width = 800, height = 450) {

    # Wrap comment text to ~60 chars per line
    wrapped <- str_wrap(comment, width = 60)

    p <- ggplot() +
        # Card background
        annotate("rect",
                xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
                fill = "#1a1a2e", color = NA) +
        # Accent bar
        annotate("rect",
                xmin = 0, xmax = 0.006, ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
                fill = "#e94560", color = NA) +
        # Quote mark
        annotate("text",
                x = 0.08, y = 0.82,
                label = "\u201c",
                hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                size = 28, color = "#e94560", fontface = "bold") +
        # Comment body
        annotate("text",
                x = 0.08, y = 0.62,
                label = wrapped,
                hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                size = 5.2, color = "#eaeaea",
                lineheight = 1.45) +
        # Country label
        annotate("text",
                x = 0.08, y = 0.12,
                label = paste0("\u2014 ", country),
                hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
                size = 5, color = "#e94560", fontface = "bold") +
        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e", color = NA))

    ggsave(out_path, plot = p,
            width = width / 96, height = height / 96, dpi = 96,
            bg = "#1a1a2e")

    message("Saved: ", out_path)
    }


Location <- file.path("/home", "david", "Documents", "CytometryInR_Metrics", "outputs")
files <- list.files(Location, pattern=".txt", full.names=TRUE)


input_file <- files[5]
output_dir <- file.path("poster", "outputs", "Improve")

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

comments <- parse_comments(input_file)

for (idx in seq_along(comments)) {
  entry    <- comments[[idx]]
  filename <- file.path(output_dir,
                        sprintf("comment_%02d_%s.png",
                                idx,
                                gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", entry$country)))
  render_comment_png(entry$country, entry$comment, filename)
}

message("Done! ", length(comments), " PNG(s) written to '", output_dir, "/'.")
